name: Stemwede (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over light blue, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Stemwede (a sword between fleurs-de-lis on blue above a yellow mount).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident of 6 February 1975 the municipality of Stemwede was granted the right to bear arms, a flag and a banner; the flag is white and blue striped 1:1 with the municipal shield shifted from the centre towards the staff.

features.role: Stemwede arms — sword, fleurs-de-lis and mount
